verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global-employment SaaS platform with a public API, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence documents a REST API, webhooks, developer sandboxes and an llms.txt file, but nothing about an MCP server. llms.txt and the API are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
